posts.title: Is it a Wound or a Well?
posts.description: I recently presented at a conference for a thousand people who had lost a child — possibly one of the most unnatural and painful things someone can experience as a parent. At the conference there were many tears. There was also laughter, there were smiles and hugs. And so much love. And although I couldn't see it with my eyes, I know there was anger. Guilt. Resentment.
